class Animal:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
    def speak(self):
        print("Some sound")
class Dog(Animal):
    def __init__(self, name, breed):
        super().__init__(name) # call the parent constructor
        self.breed = breed
    def speak(self): # overrides the parent method
        print(self.name, "says Bhow Bhow")
d = Dog("Seru", "Indie")
d.speak()
print(d.breed)
Note: Overriding = the child defines a method with the same name. super() calls the parent version.
